verdict.rationale: USCIS documents a sanctioned representation rail. An attorney or accredited representative files Form G-28 to establish eligibility to represent a client, and can then file forms online on the client's behalf through a dedicated representative online account. The Torch Case Status API also explicitly serves customers' representatives. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the representative workflow, and documentation of how far online G-28 filing extends (it is stated only for 'certain pending forms').

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: An attorney or accredited representative must submit Form G-28, Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative, to establish eligibility to represent a client in an immigration matter before USCIS.
To file a form online on behalf of your client, along with Form G-28, you must first create a USCIS online account.
In your USCIS representative online account, navigate to File a Form, and choose Form G-28
Provides case status information to USCIS customers and their representatives who require regular access to case status information.
